restraints_config._comment: RGI RMSD restraint: drive the Kabsch-superposed RMSD of atom_selection_target toward target_rmsd, measured vs a reference PDB (ref_pdb + atom_selection_ref); minimized by CG each step. Generate ref_pdb first, e.g. a vanilla prediction of this sequence converted to PDB (gemmi make_pdb_string). RUN: protenix pred -i rmsd_example.json -o out --use_default_params true --use_msa false --seeds 0 --step 200 --sample 1 --cycle 4. Atoms pair by selection ORDER and the two selections MUST match in count (mismatch -> error). Selection DSL is chain/resid/index (no atom names).

rmsd_restraints_config._comment: Drive residues 90-180 to match the reference (RMSD -> 0). start_sigma optional (omit -> every step); weight optional (default 1.0).
